title: Spinach: modeled ₹245/qtl left, Naraingarh → Thanesar
summary: May 2023: reported spinach prices at Naraingarh and Thanesar imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 85% of 27 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹245 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 120 same-variety market pairs screened for spinach in May 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Thanesar report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: May 2023
scenes.caption: Naraingarh (Haryana) and Thanesar (Haryana) both reported spinach prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 27 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Naraingarh reported a median ₹1,000 per quintal. Thanesar reported a median ₹1,500 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹400/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹400 per quintal, and Thanesar was dearer on 85% of days.

scenes.headline: 74 km by road
scenes.caption: 74 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹16/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹242 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹162 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Thanesar report, the rule selects 22 of 27 modeled shipping days. 20 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹245 per quintal (₹168 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Spinach route from Naraingarh to Thanesar was positive on 85% of matched days in May 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹24,500, or ₹16,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to spinach
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹16/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Spinach route from Naraingarh to Thanesar was positive on 85% of matched days in May 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹24,500, or ₹16,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
